title: COMMAND BLESSINGS THIS MORNING
text: Hallelujah. Glory to God. I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are right now. Whether you are in your room, in your car, in your office, at the marketplace, lift up your hands to the Lord. We are not here by accident. The spirit of the living God has orchestrated this divine moment. There is something that heaven wants to release over your life this morning. And I pray that as we engage the atmosphere of the miraculous, every gate that has been shut against you will open by fire in the mighty name of Jesus. I decree and I declare that this is your morning of unusual turnings. This is your morning of supernatural interventions. This is your morning where the command blessings of the Almighty will locate you and catapult you into dimensions that you have only dreamed about. Can I hear a thunderous amen? You see, the Bible makes us understand something very profound. In the book of Deuteronomy chapter 28, God speaks about blessings that come upon you and overtake you. Now, I want you to pay attention to that word overtake. It means blessings that pursue you, blessings that haunt you down, blessings that locate you even when you're not looking for them. These are not blessings you have to beg for. These are not blessings you have to struggle for. These are command blessings. When God commands a blessing, it means the blessing has no choice but to obey. When God commands favor, favor must answer. When God commands doors to open, those doors cannot remain closed. When God commands wealth to come to you, poverty must pack its bags and leave your territory. I don't know who I'm talking to right now, but I'm speaking to somebody who has been waiting for a breakthrough. You've been praying, you've been fasting, you've been sewing seeds, you've been believing God, and it looks like nothing is happening. But I came to announce to you this morning that your season of command blessings has begun. The Bible says in Psalm 133, "Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. It is like the precious ointment upon the head that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard that went down to the skirts of his garments, as the dew of Hmon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion. For there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life forever more. Did you see that? Where there is unity, where there is agreement, where there is harmony in the spirit, the Lord commands the blessing. I want to prophesy to somebody here today. The enemy has tried to isolate you. The enemy has tried to disconnect you from divine relationships. The enemy has tried to make you walk alone. But I prophesy that God is reconnecting you with people who carry the same vision, people who carry the same mandate, people who carry the same anointing. And in that place of unity, the Lord will command blessings upon your life that will shock you. Every spirit of isolation, break by fire. Every spirit of loneliness, scatter by fire. Every spirit that has disconnected you from your destiny helpers, I command you to release them now in the name of Jesus. Let me tell you something about command blessings. When God commands a blessing over your life, it doesn't matter what the economy is doing. It doesn't matter what the situation in your nation looks like. It doesn't matter what your bank account is saying. It doesn't matter what your medical report is declaring. When God commands blessing, supernatural provision shows up. When God commands blessing, divine health manifests. When God commands blessing, opportunities that you didn't apply for begin to locate you. I remember the story of Isaac in Genesis chapter 26. There was famine in the land. Now you would think that during farming the reasonable thing to do would be to relocate, to run away, to go where there is food. But God gave Isaac a strange instruction. God said, "Don't go down to Egypt. Stay in the land that I will show you." And the Bible records something miraculous. In the same year, not after 10 years, not after 5 years, but in the same year of famine, Isaac sowed and reaped a hundfold. The Bible says the man became great, and he continued to become greater and greater until he became very great. How is it possible to prosper in a season of recession? How is it possible to excel when others are failing? How is it possible to be promoted when others are being demoted? It is because of command blessings. When God commands blessing upon your life, you will flourish in the desert. You will excel in difficult times. You will prosper when others are struggling. I prophesy upon your life right now. You will not be a victim of circumstances. You will not be limited by the season. You will not be restricted by what is happening around you. The command of the Lord upon your life is blessing. And that blessing will manifest now in Jesus mighty name. Before we go into the place of prayer and I believe we are going to engage heaven in a way that will transform your situation. I want you to understand the spiritual technology behind command blessings. You see in the beginning God created the heavens and the earth and the Bible says the earth was without form and void and darkness was upon the face of the deep. But then God spoke. Genesis 1:3 says and God said let there be light and there was light. What happened? A command was issued and creation had to obey. This is the same God who has made you in his image and after his likeness. The same God who gave you dominion. The same God who has crowned you with glory and honor. And when this God opens his mouth and commands blessing upon your life, every contrary voice must be silenced. Every negative report must bow. Every evil projection must collapse. I decree that every word that has been spoken against your destiny, every curse that has been released against your family, every evil pronouncement that has been made concerning your business, I command them to scatter now by the fire of the Holy Ghost. And let me tell you something powerful. If you've been blessed by this word so far, if something in your spirit is already leaping, I want you to take a moment right now and share this message with someone. Send it to your family members. Send it to your friends. Send it to your colleagues. There is somebody in your contact list who needs to hear this word. There is somebody who is discouraged, somebody who is frustrated, somebody who is about to give up. And this message will reignite their faith. Don't keep this blessing to yourself. Be a channel. Be a vessel. Share this word. And as you do, the same blessings you're praying for will be multiplied back to you sevenfold. Now, let me take you deeper into the revelation of command blessings. In the book of Numbers chapter 6, God gave Moses a pattern of blessing. He said, "Speak unto Aaron and unto his son, saying, on these wise he shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them, the Lord bless thee and keep thee. The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee. The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee and give thee peace. And then God said something powerful in verse 27. And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel and I will bless them. When the name of the Lord is upon your life, blessing is automatic. When the name of the Lord is upon your life, favor is guaranteed. When the name of the Lord is upon your life, protection is assured. The enemy may try, but he cannot succeed. Pharaoh may pursue, but he cannot overtake. Golth may roar but he cannot intimidate because the name of the Lord is upon you and that name is a strong tower. The righteous run into it and they are safe. I want to prophesy to you this morning. Every attack that the enemy has launched against you, it will backfire. Every trap that has been set for you, the enemy will fall into his own trap. Every pit that has been dug for you, your enemies will fall into that pit. Every weapon that has been fashioned against you, it shall not prosper, and every tongue that rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn. This is your heritage as a servant of the Lord, and your righteousness is from me, says the Lord of hosts. Now, when we talk about command blessings this morning, we must understand that there are levels to blessings in the kingdom. There are blessings that come as a result of your obedience. Deuteronomy 28:1 says, "And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth." These are conditional blessings. They require your cooperation, your obedience, your dedication. But there is another dimension of blessing that I call sovereign blessing. This is when God in his mercy, in his grace, in his love decides to bless you not because of what you did, but because of who he is. This is the blessing that came upon Abraham. The Bible says in Genesis 12, "Now the Lord had said unto Abraham, get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will show thee, and I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great, and thou shalt be a blessing." Abraham didn't do anything to deserve this blessing. God just chose him. God just selected him. God just picked him out from among the nations and said, "I will bless you." And when God makes that kind of declaration, when God releases that kind of command, no devil in hell can cancel it, no witchcraft can reverse it, no enemy can abort it. I prophesy that God is about to release sovereign blessings upon your life, blessings that you didn't work for, blessings that you didn't earn, blessings that you don't deserve, but God in his mercy has decided to release them over you. You know, one of the most powerful examples of command blessing in the New Testament is found in the book of Luke chapter 5. Jesus had been teaching the people from Peter's boat. And when he was done, he said to Peter, "Launch out into the deep and let down your net for a draft." Now, Peter was a professional fisherman. He had been fishing all night and caught nothing. But something about the command of Jesus, something about the authority in his voice made Peter say, "Master, we have toiled all the night and have taken nothing." Nevertheless, at thy word, I will let down the net. And what happened? The Bible says they enclosed a great multitude of fishes, so much so that their net broke. They had to signal to their partners in another boat to come and help them. and they filled both boats so full that they began to sink. This is what happens when Jesus commands blessing. This is what happens when the Lord of the harvest speaks prosperity over your life. You move from scarcity to abundance. You move from struggle to overflow. You move from barely enough to more than enough. I want to pause here and pray for somebody. There is someone reading this right now and you've been toiling. You've been working hard. You've been putting in the effort. You've been sewing seeds. You've been investing. You've been believing God, but it seems like your net is still empty. It seems like the harvest has not come. It seems like the breakthrough is delayed. But I came to announce to you that your season of empty nets is over. This is your season of the miraculous catch. This is your season where God will surprise you with overflow. This is your season where your business will explode. Your ministry will expand. Your career will skyrocket. Your finances will overflow. Somebody shout this is my season of overflow. Let me show you another dimension of command blessings from the life of Joseph. Joseph was a dreamer. God gave him visions of greatness. But before the manifestation of those dreams, Joseph went through pit experiences, prison experiences, betrayal experiences. His own brother sold him into slavery. Portifer's wife falsely accused him. The butler he helped in prison forgot about him. But in Genesis 39-2, the Bible makes a powerful statement. And the Lord was with Joseph and he was a prosperous man. How can you be in slavery and still be prosperous? How can you be in prison and still have favor? Is because when God commands blessing, your location cannot limit you. Your circumstances cannot restrict you. Your challenges cannot define you. Joseph prospered in Portifer's house. The Bible says everything he touched prospered. Even when he was thrown into prison, the Bible says the Lord gave him favor in the sight of the prison keeper. And whatever he did, the Lord made it to prosper. I prophesy upon your life. Your current location is not your final destination. Where you are right now is not where you will end. The pit is not your portion. The prison is not your permanent address. God is about to promote you. God is about to elevate you. God is about to turn your situation around. Everything that the enemy has used to push you down will become the platform that God will use to lift you up. From the pit to the palace, from the prison to the throne, from obscurity to prominence, from lack to abundance. This is your season of divine elevation. Now, as we prepare to engage heaven in prayer, I want you to understand something about the spiritual climate we're entering. The Bible says in Ephesians 1:3, "Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who had blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ." Notice that the blessing is already done. God has already blessed you. The question is, are you accessing it? Are you walking in it? Are you manifesting it? You see, many believers are living below their covenant privileges because they don't understand spiritual realities. They are waiting for God to bless them. not knowing that God has already released the blessing. What you need is not a new blessing. What you need is the revelation to access what has already been deposited in the heavenly realms. When you pray, you are not trying to convince God to bless you. You are pulling down what heaven has already released. This is why Jesus taught us to pray in Matthew 6:10, "Thy kingdom come, thy will be done in earth as it is in heaven." In heaven, you are already blessed. In heaven, you're already healed. In heaven, you're already prosperous. In heaven, you're already victorious. So when you pray, you're bringing heaven's reality into your earthly experience. You're enforcing what has already been declared in the courts of heaven. I need you to get violent in the spirit. Right now, I need you to wake up. I need you to stir up the gift that is within you. The Bible says the kingdom of heaven suffers violence and the violent take it by force. This is not the time to be gentle with the enemy. This is not the time to be passive in the spirit. This is the time to rise up as a warrior. This is the time to take your position as a king and a priest. This is the time to enforce the dominion that God has given you. Let me tell you about the authority you carry as a believer. In Luke 10:19, Jesus said, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you." Do you know what this means? It means you have authority over every demonic force. You have authority over every satanic strategy. You have authority over every evil manipulation. When you open your mouth and decree the name of Jesus, demons tremble. When you declare the word of God, darkness scatters. When you prophesy blessings, heaven responds. So right now, before we pray, I want you to make a declaration. I want you to open your mouth and say, "I am blessed. I am favored. I am highly favored of the Lord. I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. I am a lender and not a borrower. Poverty is not my portion. Sickness is not my heritage. Failure is not my destiny. I am blessed with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ Jesus. Every curse is broken. Every limitation is destroyed. Every barrier is removed. This is my season of command blessings. Now, let me show you one more powerful truth before we go into warfare prayer. In the book of Malachi chapter 3, God addresses the issue of robbery. He says, "Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me? But ye say, wherein have we robbed thee in tithes and offerings?" And then God gives a powerful instruction in verse 10. Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house and prove me now herew which said the Lord of hosts if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. This is one of the few places in scripture where God says test me prove me try me. God is so confident in his ability to bless you that he's challenging you to put him to the test. And what is the promise? that he will open the windows of heaven. Not the door, the windows. When a door opens, one person can walk through. But when windows are open, it's an overflow. It's an avalanche. It's a flood of blessings. And then God says something even more powerful in verse 11. And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes. And he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground. Neither shall your vine cast out fruit before the time in the field, sayeth the Lord of hosts. God promises to rebuke the devourer. That means every spirit that has been eating your blessings, every force that has been consuming your harvest, every enemy that has been stealing your joy, God himself will rebuke them. I prophesy upon your life right now. Every devourer in your life, receive the rebuke of the Lord. Every spirit of wastage scattered by fire. Every leak in your finances, be sealed by the blood of Jesus. Every hole in your pocket be closed by divine authority. From today, what comes into your hands will stay in your hands. The devourer is rebuked. The waster is bound. The thief is paralyzed. And the blessings of the Lord will rest upon you.
